claim_verdicts.basis: The claim states that at 10:00 today the courier capsule was not ready because its valve cap was loose. The cited evidence at the same 10:00 time states the pressure is four bars but the cap remains loose and unlocked throughout that minute. The memory rule states readiness requires both four bars pressure and a locked valve cap. Since the cap was loose and unlocked at 10:00, the capsule was not ready under the rule, which is fully consistent with the claim. No contradiction exists.
